bookInfo.name: Old History of the Five Dynasties

title.zh: 卷三十一 唐書7: 莊宗本紀五
title.en: Volume 31 Book of Later Tang 7: Zhuangzong Annals 5
title.raw: 卷三十一 唐書7: 莊宗本紀五 Volume 31 Book of Later Tang 7: Zhuangzong Annals 5

sentences.zh: 同光二年春正月庚子朔，帝御明堂殿受朝賀，仗衛如式。

translations.literal: Spring, first month, Tongguang year 2, gengzi new moon: the Emperor took the Mingtang Hall to receive new-year congratulations; guards and escort followed the prescribed form.
translations.idiomatic: On the gengzi new moon in spring of Tongguang 2, Cunxu held new-year court in Mingtang Hall with full guard.

sentences.zh: 壬寅，南郊禮儀使、太常卿李燕進太廟登歌酌獻樂舞名，懿祖室曰《昭德之舞》，獻祖室曰《文明之舞》，太祖室曰《應天之舞》，昭宗室曰《永平之舞》。

translations.literal: On renchen, Director of Southern Suburbs Rites and Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Li Yan presented the names of the ascent songs, libation offerings, and dances for the Imperial Ancestral Temple: for the chamber of the Honored Ancestor, the 《Dance of Manifest Virtue》; for the Offered Ancestor, the 《Dance of Civilizing Brilliance》; for the Grand Ancestor, the 《Dance of Responding to Heaven》; for Zhaozong, the 《Dance of Eternal Peace》.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Li Yan of the rites office submitted temple dance names: Honored Ancestor, 《Dance of Manifest Virtue》; Offered Ancestor, 《Dance of Civilizing Brilliance》; Grand Ancestor, 《Dance of Responding to Heaven》; Zhaozong, 《Dance of Eternal Peace》.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，幽州上言，契丹入寇至瓦橋。

translations.literal: On jiachen Youzhou reported that the Khitan had raided as far as Wa Bridge.
translations.idiomatic: On jiachen Youzhou reported Khitan raiders at Wa Bridge.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《契丹國志》：時契丹日益強盛，遣使就唐求幽州，以處盧文進。）〉

translations.literal: (The 《Records of the Khitan State》 says: At that time the Khitan grew daily stronger and sent envoys to Tang to ask for Youzhou to settle Lu Wenjin.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Records of the Khitan State》 says the Khitan were growing stronger and asked Tang for Youzhou for Lu Wenjin.)〉

sentences.zh: 以天平軍節度使李嗣源為北面行營都招討使，陝州留後霍彥威為副，率軍援幽州。

translations.literal: Tianping military commissioner Li Siyuan was made overall northern campaign commander, with Shanzhou acting prefect Huo Yanwei as deputy, to lead troops to relieve Youzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Li Siyuan of Tianping was made northern commander with Huo Yanwei of Shanzhou as deputy to relieve Youzhou.

sentences.zh: 己巳，故宣武軍節度副使、權知軍州事、檢校太傅王瓚贈太子太師。

translations.literal: On jisi the late Xuanwu deputy commissioner, acting prefect, and Grand Mentor Wang Zan was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.
translations.idiomatic: On jisi the late Wang Zan of Xuanwu was posthumously made Grand Preceptor.

sentences.zh: 丁未，詔改朝元殿復為明堂殿，又改崇勳殿為中興殿。

translations.literal: On dingwei an edict changed Chaoyuan Hall back to Mingtang Hall and Chongxun Hall to Zhongxing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: On dingwei Chaoyuan Hall was restored to Mingtang and Chongxun to Zhongxing.

sentences.zh: 戊申，以振武軍節度使、檢校太傅、同平章事李存霸權知潞州留後；

translations.literal: On wushen Zhenwu military commissioner, Grand Mentor, and co-equal chief minister Li Cunba was made acting Lu prefect;
translations.idiomatic: On wushen Li Cunba of Zhenwu was made acting Lu prefect;

sentences.zh: 以知保大軍軍州事高允韜為檢校太保。

translations.literal: Gao Yuntao, who held Baoda army and prefecture affairs, was made Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: and Gao Yuntao of Baoda was made Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，以涇原節度使、充秦王府諸道行軍司馬、開府儀同三司、檢校太尉、兼侍中李從嚴為檢校太尉、兼中書令，依前涇原軍節度使，充秦王府諸道行軍司馬。

translations.literal: On gengxu Jingyuan military commissioner, Qin Prince campaign marshal, Grand Preceptor, and vice director Li Congyan was made Grand Preceptor and chief minister, remaining Jingyuan commissioner and Qin Prince campaign marshal.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Li Congyan of Jingyuan was made Grand Preceptor and chief minister while keeping Jingyuan and Qin Prince posts.

sentences.zh: 詔改應順門為永曜門，太平門為萬春門，通政門為廣政門，鳳明門為韶和門，萬春門為中興門，解卸殿為端明殿。

translations.literal: An edict changed Yingshun Gate to Yongyao Gate, Taiping Gate to Wanchun Gate, Tongzheng Gate to Guangzheng Gate, Fengming Gate to Shaohe Gate, Wanchun Gate to Zhongxing Gate, and Jiezhuang Hall to Duanming Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Gates and halls were renamed: Yingshun to Yongyao, Taiping to Wanchun, Tongzheng to Guangzheng, Fengming to Shaohe, Wanchun to Zhongxing, Jiezhuang to Duanming.

sentences.zh: 是日，詔曰：「皇綱已正，紫禁方嚴，凡事內官，不合更居外地。

translations.literal: That day an edict said: "The imperial net is already set right and the Forbidden City is now strict; in general palace eunuchs should not again reside outside the capital.
translations.idiomatic: That day an edict read, "The throne is secure and the palace strict; palace eunuchs must not live outside the capital.

sentences.zh: 詔諸道應有內官，不計高低，並仰逐處並家口發遣赴闕，不得輒有停滯。

translations.literal: All circuits with eunuchs, regardless of rank, are ordered to send them and their households to court at once from each place, with no delay.
translations.idiomatic: Every circuit must send its eunuchs and families to court at once, without delay.

sentences.zh: 」帝龍潛時，寺人數已及五百，至是合諸道赴闕者，約千餘人，皆給賜優贍，服玩華侈，委之事務，付以腹心。

translations.literal: " While the Emperor was still heir, eunuchs already numbered five hundred; now with those from the circuits who came to court there were about a thousand, all given generous stipends and splendid dress, entrusted with affairs and treated as confidants.
translations.idiomatic: " In his days as heir Cunxu already had five hundred eunuchs; now a thousand from the circuits came to court, richly paid, splendidly dressed, and trusted with power.

sentences.zh: 唐時宦官為內諸司使務、諸鎮監軍，出納王命，造作威福，昭宗以此亡國。

translations.literal: Under Tang, eunuchs served as inner-office commissioners and circuit supervisors, issuing the royal command and making their own might; Zhaozong for this lost the state.
translations.idiomatic: Under Tang eunuchs ran inner offices and supervised circuits, wielding royal power until Zhaozong lost the realm.

sentences.zh: 及帝奄有天下，當知戒彼前車，以為殷鑒，一朝復興茲弊，議者惜之。

translations.literal: Now that the Emperor held all under heaven, he should have taken the overturned cart ahead as a warning, yet in one morning this abuse rose again—commentators lamented it.
translations.idiomatic: Having taken the realm he should have heeded that overturned cart, yet the abuse returned at once—commentators mourned it.

sentences.zh: 新羅王金樸英遣使朝貢。

translations.literal: King Geumpyeong of Silla sent envoys with tribute.
translations.idiomatic: Silla's King Geumpyeong sent tribute envoys.

sentences.zh: 辛亥，中書門下奏：「準本朝故事，諸王、內命婦、宰臣、學士、中書舍人、諸道節度、防禦、團練使、留後官告，即中書帖官告院索綾紙褾軸，下所司書寫印署畢，進入宣賜。

translations.literal: On xinhai the Secretariat memorialized: "According to our court's precedent, patent scrolls for princes, inner consorts, chief ministers, academicians, Secretariat drafters, and military commissioners, observers, and regents require the Secretariat to obtain brocade paper and mounting shafts from the Patent Office, have the relevant office write and seal them, and present them for imperial bestowal.
translations.idiomatic: On xinhai the Secretariat said, "By precedent, patents for princes, consorts, ministers, and commissioners need brocade from the Patent Office, then sealing and imperial grant.

sentences.zh: 其文武兩班及諸道官員並奏薦將校，並合於所司送納朱膠綾紙價錢。

translations.literal: Civil and military officials of both ranks and circuit officers, and commanders recommended in memorials, should all pay the price of vermilion glue and brocade paper to the relevant office.
translations.idiomatic: Other civil and military officers and recommended commanders must pay for their brocade and paper.

sentences.zh: 伏自偽梁，不分輕重，並從官給，今後如非前件事例，請官中不給告敕，其內司大官侍衛將校轉官，即不在此限。

translations.literal: Since the false Liang court, rank was not distinguished and all were supplied from government stores; hereafter, except for the cases above, the court should not supply patents; inner-office great officers, bodyguards, and commanders promoted in rank are outside this limit.
translations.idiomatic: Under Liang all ranks were supplied free; hereafter only the cases above get court paper—inner-office guards and promoted commanders excepted.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: " Approved.

sentences.zh: 壬子，蜀主王衍致書於帝，稱有詐為天使，馳報收復汴州者，詔捕之，不獲。

translations.literal: On renzi Shu ruler Wang Yan wrote the Emperor that someone had falsely posed as an envoy and rushed word that Bian had been recovered; an edict ordered his arrest, but he was not caught.
translations.idiomatic: On renzi Wang Yan of Shu wrote that a fake envoy had reported Bian recovered; Cunxu ordered arrest but found no one.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，有司奏：郊祀前二日，迎祔高祖、太宗、懿祖、獻祖、太祖神主於太廟。

translations.literal: On guichou the relevant office memorialized: two days before the suburban sacrifice, the spirit tablets of Gaozu, Taizong, the Honored Ancestor, the Offered Ancestor, and the Grand Ancestor should be welcomed and enshrined in the Imperial Temple.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou the rites office said that two days before the suburban rite the tablets of Gaozu through the Grand Ancestor should be brought to the temple.

sentences.zh: 議者以中興唐祚，不宜以追封之祖雜有國之君以為昭穆，自懿祖已下，宜別立廟於代州，如後漢南陽故事可也。

translations.literal: Commentators held that in restoring Tang's fortune one should not mix posthumously enfeoffed ancestors with reigning sovereigns in the zhao-mu order; from the Honored Ancestor down they should have separate temples at Dai prefecture, as in Later Han's Nanyang precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Some argued that restored Tang should not rank enfeoffed forebears with reigning emperors; from the Honored Ancestor down they wanted separate temples at Dai, as under Later Han.

sentences.zh: 幽州北面軍前奏，契丹還塞，詔李嗣源班師。

translations.literal: The northern Youzhou front reported that the Khitan had returned beyond the pass; an edict ordered Li Siyuan to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou reported the Khitan had left; Li Siyuan was ordered home.

sentences.zh: 鳳翔節度使、秦王李茂貞上表，請行藩臣之禮，帝優報之。

translations.literal: Fengxiang military commissioner and Qin Prince Li Maozhen memorialized asking to perform the ritual of a feudatory prince; the Emperor answered him graciously.
translations.idiomatic: Li Maozhen of Fengxiang asked to act as a feudatory prince; Cunxu answered graciously.

sentences.zh: 甲寅，帝於中興殿麵賜郭崇韜鐵券。

translations.literal: On jiayin the Emperor in person at Zhongxing Hall bestowed on Guo Chongtao an iron tally of mercy.
translations.idiomatic: On jiayin Cunxu personally gave Guo Chongtao an iron tally at Zhongxing Hall.

sentences.zh: 有司上言：「皇太后到闕，皇帝合於銀台門內奉迎。

translations.literal: The relevant office memorialized: "When the Empress Dowager reaches court, the Emperor should welcome her within the Yintai Gate.
translations.idiomatic: The rites office said the Emperor should welcome the Empress Dowager inside Yintai Gate.

sentences.zh: 」詔親至懷州奉迎。

translations.literal: " An edict ordered him to go in person to Huai prefecture to welcome her.
translations.idiomatic: Cunxu was ordered to go himself to Huai to meet her.

sentences.zh: 中書奏：「自二十三日後散齋內，車駕不合遠出。

translations.literal: The Secretariat memorialized: "From the twenty-third onward, during the scattering fast within the inner precinct, the imperial carriage should not go far.
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat said that from the twenty-third, during the fast, the court should not travel far.

sentences.zh: 」詔改至河陽奉迎。

translations.literal: " An edict changed the welcome to Heyang.
translations.idiomatic: Cunxu changed the meeting place to Heyang.

sentences.zh: 以禮部尚書、興唐尹王正言依前禮部尚書，充租庸使。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites and Xingtang prefect Wang Zhengyan remained Minister of Rites and was made commissioner of land tax and corvée.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Zhengyan stayed Minister of Rites and was made land-tax commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，渤海國遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On yimao Bohai sent envoys with regional products.
translations.idiomatic: On yimao Bohai sent tribute.

sentences.zh: 幽州奏，媯州山後十三寨百姓卻復新州。

translations.literal: Youzhou reported that the people of thirteen stockades behind the mountains of Ji prefecture had returned to Xin prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Youzhou said thirteen mountain stockades behind Ji had returned to Xin.

sentences.zh: 戊午，以前太子少師薛廷珪為檢校戶部尚書、太子少師致仕；

translations.literal: On wuwu former Grand Mentor of the Heir Xue Tinggui was made acting Minister of Revenue and Grand Mentor emeritus;
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu Xue Tinggui was made acting revenue minister and retired Grand Mentor;

sentences.zh: 以前太子賓客封舜卿為太子少保致仕；

translations.literal: former Grand Mentor of the Heir Feng Shunqing was made Grand Guardian emeritus;
translations.idiomatic: Feng Shunqing, Grand Guardian emeritus;

sentences.zh: 以前太子賓客李文規為戶部侍郎致仕。

translations.literal: former Grand Mentor of the Heir Li Wengui was made Vice Minister of Revenue emeritus.
translations.idiomatic: and Li Wengui, Vice Minister of Revenue emeritus.

sentences.zh: 詔鹽鐵、度支、戶部並委租庸使管轄。

translations.literal: An edict placed the salt monopoly, revenue, and household bureaus all under the land-tax commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Salt, revenue, and household bureaus were placed under the land-tax commissioner.

sentences.zh: 庚申，四方館上言：「請今後除隨駕將校，及外方進奉專使文武班三品以上官，可以內殿對見，其餘並詣正衙，以申常禮。

translations.literal: On gengshen the Office for Guests from the Four Quarters memorialized: "Hereafter, except for commanders with the imperial train and special envoys from abroad who are civil or military officials of third rank or above and may be received in the inner hall, all others should attend at the main court to observe regular ritual.
translations.idiomatic: On gengshen the guest office asked that only third-rank envoys with the train or on tribute missions use the inner hall; others should use the main court.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 車駕幸河陽，奉迎皇太后。

translations.literal: The imperial train went to Heyang to welcome the Empress Dowager.
translations.idiomatic: Cunxu went to Heyang to meet the Empress Dowager.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，帝侍皇太后至，文武百僚迎於上東門。

translations.literal: On xinyou the Emperor attended the Empress Dowager on her arrival; civil and military officials of a hundred ranks welcomed her at Shangdong Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On xinyou Cunxu escorted her in; the hundred officials met them at Shangdong Gate.

sentences.zh: 是日，河中府上言，稷山縣割隸絳州。

translations.literal: That day Hezhong prefecture reported that Jishan county was detached to Jiang prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: That day Hezhong said Jishan county was transferred to Jiang.

sentences.zh: 以太僕卿李紓為宗正卿，以衛尉卿楊遘為太僕卿。

translations.literal: Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Li Shu was made Director of the Imperial Clan; Minister of the Imperial Stud Yang Di was made Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: Li Shu became Director of the Imperial Clan; Yang Di became Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.

sentences.zh: 西京昭應縣華清宮道士張衝虛上言，天尊院枯檜重生枝葉。

translations.literal: Zhang Chongxu, a Huaqing Palace Daoist of Zhaoying county in the Western Capital, reported that a withered cypress in the Hall of the Heavenly Honored One had put out new branches and leaves.
translations.idiomatic: A Huaqing Daoist reported the withered cypress at the Hall of the Heavenly Honored One had leafed again.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，有司上言：「南郊朝享太廟，舊例親王充亞獻、終獻行事。

translations.literal: On yichou the relevant office memorialized: "At the southern suburb and Imperial Temple offerings, by old precedent a prince performed the second and final libations.
translations.idiomatic: On yichou the rites office said princes had traditionally performed the second and final libations at temple and altar.

sentences.zh: 」乃以皇子繼岌為亞獻，皇弟存紀為終獻。

translations.literal: " Prince Jiji was then made second libationer and the Emperor's brother Cunji final libationer.
translations.idiomatic: Jiji was made second libationer and Cunji final libationer.

sentences.zh: 丙寅，帝赴明堂殿致齋。

translations.literal: On bingyin the Emperor went to Mingtang Hall to fast.
translations.idiomatic: On bingyin Cunxu fasted at Mingtang.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，朝饗於太微宮。

translations.literal: On dingmao he offered food at the Taiwei Palace.
translations.idiomatic: On dingmao he offered food at Taiwei Palace.

sentences.zh: 戊辰，饗太廟，是日赴南郊。

translations.literal: On wuchen he offered food at the Imperial Temple; that day he went to the southern suburb.
translations.idiomatic: On wuchen he fed the temple, then went to the southern altar.

sentences.zh: 二月己巳朔，親祀昊天上帝於圜丘，禮畢，宰臣率百官就次稱賀，還禦五鳳樓。

translations.literal: Second month, jisi new moon: he personally sacrificed to August Heaven on the round altar; when the rite was done the chief ministers led the hundred officials to their places to offer congratulations, and he returned to hold Wufeng Tower.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi new moon of the second month Cunxu sacrificed to Heaven on the round altar, received congratulations, and returned to Wufeng Tower.

sentences.zh: 宣製：「大赦天下，應同光二年二月一日昧爽已前，所犯罪無輕重常赦所不原者，咸赦除之。

translations.literal: He proclaimed: "A great amnesty for all under heaven: for crimes committed before dawn on the first day of the second month of Tongguang 2, of whatever weight, even those the regular amnesty does not cover—all are pardoned.
translations.idiomatic: He proclaimed a great amnesty: all crimes before dawn on the first of the second month of Tongguang 2, even those usually excluded, were pardoned.

sentences.zh: 十惡五逆、屠牛鑄錢、故意殺人、合造毒藥、持杖行劫、官典犯贓，不在此限。

translations.literal: The ten abominations, five rebellions, slaughtering cattle, coining money, deliberate homicide, compounding poison, armed robbery, and official embezzlement are outside the limit.
translations.idiomatic: The ten abominations, coining, murder, poison, robbery, and embezzlement were excluded.

sentences.zh: 應自來立功將校，各與轉官，仍加賞給。

translations.literal: All commanders who have won merit from the beginning shall each be promoted in rank and further rewarded.
translations.idiomatic: Meritorious commanders were promoted and rewarded.

sentences.zh: 文武常參官、節度、觀察、防禦、刺史、軍主、都虞候、指揮使，父母亡歿者，並與追贈；

translations.literal: Regular civil officials, military commissioners, observers, defenders, prefects, army chiefs, and commanders whose parents have died shall each receive posthumous honors;
translations.idiomatic: Officials and commissioners whose parents had died received posthumous honors;

sentences.zh: 在者各與加爵增封。

translations.literal: those still living shall each receive added noble rank and enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: living parents received added rank.

sentences.zh: 諸藩鎮各賜一子出身，仍封功臣名號。

translations.literal: Each military commissioner shall have one son given initial office and a title of meritorious minister.
translations.idiomatic: Each commissioner's son entered office with a merit title.

sentences.zh: 留後、刺史，官高者加階爵一級，官卑者加官一資。

translations.literal: For regents and prefects, the high in rank receive one step of noble rank; the low receive one grade of office.
translations.idiomatic: High regents and prefects gained a noble step; low ones gained an office grade.

sentences.zh: 應本朝內外臣僚，被朱氏殺害者，特與追贈。

translations.literal: All civil and military servants of this court whom the Zhu clan killed shall specially receive posthumous honors.
translations.idiomatic: Tang servants killed by the Zhu were posthumously honored.

sentences.zh: 應諸州府不得令富室分外收貯見錢，禁工人熔錢為銅器，勿令商人載錢出境。

translations.literal: No prefecture or circuit may let rich houses hoard cash beyond measure; craftsmen must not melt coin into bronze vessels; merchants must not carry coin across the border.
translations.idiomatic: Rich houses could not hoard cash, smiths could not melt coin, and merchants could not export money.

sentences.zh: 近年已來，婦女服飾，異常寬博，倍費縑綾。

translations.literal: In recent years women's dress has been unusually wide and has doubled the cost in silk.
translations.idiomatic: Women's dress had grown extravagantly wide and costly.

sentences.zh: 有力之家，不計卑賤，悉衣錦繡，宜令所在糾察。

translations.literal: Powerful families, heedless of rank, all wore brocade and embroidery; local authorities should investigate and restrain this.
translations.idiomatic: The powerful wore brocade regardless of rank; local authorities were to stop it.

sentences.zh: 應有百姓婦女，曾經俘擄他處為婢妾者，一任骨肉識認。

translations.literal: Common women who were once taken captive elsewhere as concubines may be reclaimed by kin.
translations.idiomatic: Women taken as captives might be reclaimed by kin.

sentences.zh: 男子曾被刺麵者，給與憑據，放逐營生。

translations.literal: Men who had been tattooed on the face should be given credentials and released to make a living.
translations.idiomatic: Tattooed men were to get papers and be freed to work.

sentences.zh: 召天下有能以書籍進納者，各等第酬獎。

translations.literal: Summon all under heaven who can present books: each shall be rewarded by grade.
translations.idiomatic: Book donors were to be rewarded by grade.

sentences.zh: 仰有司速檢勘天下戶口正額，墾田實數，待憑條理，以息煩苛。

translations.literal: The relevant offices should quickly audit the realm's registered households and actual cultivated land, to be governed by rule and ease harsh exactions.
translations.idiomatic: Offices were to audit households and farmland to ease exactions.

sentences.zh: 」是日，風景和暢，人胥悅服。

translations.literal: " That day the weather was mild and all were pleased.
translations.idiomatic: " That day the weather was fair and the people rejoiced.

sentences.zh: 議者雲，五十年來無此盛禮。

translations.literal: Commentators said there had been no such grand rite in fifty years.
translations.idiomatic: Commentators said no such rite had been seen in fifty years.

sentences.zh: 然自此權臣愎戾，伶官用事，吏人孔謙酷加賦斂，赦文之所原放，謙復刻剝不行，大失人心，始於此矣。

translations.literal: Yet from this time powerful ministers grew obstinate, actor-officials held office, and clerk Kong Qian harshly added levies; what the amnesty had remitted Qian again exacted and would not carry out—greatly losing hearts, it began here.
translations.idiomatic: Yet from then on ministers turned stubborn, actors held power, and Kong Qian re-levied what the amnesty had freed—hearts were lost from this day.

sentences.zh: 庚午，租庸使孔謙奏：「諸道綱運客旅，多於私路苟免商稅，請令所在關防嚴加捉搦。

translations.literal: On gengwu land-tax commissioner Kong Qian memorialized: "Transport convoys and traveling merchants on the circuits often evade commercial tax on private routes; order every pass and barrier to seize them strictly.
translations.idiomatic: On gengwu Kong Qian asked that convoys and merchants evading tax on private roads be seized at every pass.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: " It was approved.
translations.idiomatic: Approved.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，宰臣豆盧革率百官上尊號，曰昭文睿武至德光孝皇帝，凡三上表，從之。

translations.literal: On guiyou chief minister Dou Luge led the hundred officials in offering an honorific title: Illustrious in Culture, Sagacious in Warfare, Utmost in Virtue, Radiant in Filial Piety Emperor; after three memorials it was approved.
translations.idiomatic: On guiyou Dou Luge led three memorials offering the title Illustrious in Culture, Sagacious in Warfare, Utmost in Virtue, Radiant in Filial Piety; Cunxu accepted.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，詔曰：「汴州元管開封、浚儀、封丘、雍丘、尉氏、陳留六縣，偽庭割許州鄢陵、扶溝，陳州太康，鄭州陽武、中牟，曹州考城等縣屬焉。

translations.literal: On jiaxu an edict said: "Bian prefecture originally governed six counties—Kaifeng, Junyi, Fengqiu, Yongqiu, Weishi, and Chenliu; the false court cut Yingling and Fugou from Xu, Taikang from Chen, Yangwu and Zhongmou from Zheng, and Kaocheng from Cao and attached them.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu an edict restored Bian's six counties and said Yingling, Fugou, Taikang, Yangwu, Zhongmou, and Kaocheng had been cut to Liang;

sentences.zh: 其陽武、匡城、扶溝、考城四縣，宜令且隸汴州，餘還本部。

translations.literal: Yangwu, Kuangcheng, Fugou, and Kaocheng should for now remain under Bian; the rest return to their original jurisdictions.
translations.idiomatic: Yangwu, Kuangcheng, Fugou, and Kaocheng would stay with Bian; the rest went home.

sentences.zh: 」丙子，以隨駕參謀耿瑗為司天監。

translations.literal: On bingzi Geng Yuan, staff officer with the imperial train, was made Director of Astronomy.
translations.idiomatic: On bingzi staff officer Geng Yuan became Director of Astronomy.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以光祿大夫、檢校司徒李筠為右騎衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On dingchou Grand Master of Splendid Happiness and acting Minister of Works Li Yun was made General of the Right Horse Guards.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Li Yun became General of the Right Horse Guards.

sentences.zh: 戊寅，幸李嗣源第，作樂，盡歡而罷。

translations.literal: On wuyin he visited Li Siyuan's residence, made music, and parted in full pleasure.
translations.idiomatic: On wuyin Cunxu feasted at Li Siyuan's house and left in high spirits.

sentences.zh: 己卯，以河中節度使、冀王李繼麟兼安邑、解縣兩池榷鹽使。

translations.literal: On jimao Hezhong military commissioner and Prince of Ji Li Jilin was also made salt commissioner for Anyi and Jie counties.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Li Jilin of Hezhong was made salt commissioner for Anyi and Jie.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，以檢校太師、守尚書令、河南尹、判六軍諸衛事、魏王張全義為守太尉、兼中書令、河陽節度使、河南尹，改封齊王。

translations.literal: On xinsi Grand Preceptor, acting Director of the Secretariat, Henan prefect, and commander of the Six Armies and guards Zhang Quanyi was made acting Grand Preceptor, chief minister, Heyang military commissioner, and Henan prefect, and enfeoffed as Prince of Qi.
translations.idiomatic: On xinsi Zhang Quanyi became Grand Preceptor, chief minister, Heyang commissioner, and Prince of Qi.

sentences.zh: 以開府儀同三司、守尚書令、秦王李茂貞依前封秦王，餘如故，仍賜不拜、不名。

translations.literal: Acting Director of the Secretariat and Qin Prince Li Maozhen remained Prince of Qin with all else as before, and was also granted exemption from bowing and from having his name spoken.
translations.idiomatic: Li Maozhen stayed Qin Prince with exemption from bowing and from naming his name.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：太常禮院奏：「李茂貞封冊之命，宜準故襄州節度使趙匡凝之例施行。

translations.literal: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices memorialized: "For Li Maozhen's enfeoffment patent the precedent of former Xiangzhou military commissioner Zhao Kuangning should be followed.
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Institutions of the Five Dynasties》 says the sacrifice office cited Zhao Kuangning's precedent for Maozhen's patent.

sentences.zh: 秦王受冊，自備革輅一乘，載冊犢車一乘，並本品鹵簿鼓吹如儀。

translations.literal: The Qin Prince receiving the patent should himself provide one leather carriage and one calf-cart bearing the patent, with full insignia and music as prescribed.
translations.idiomatic: Maozhen was to supply his own carriage and patent cart with full insignia and music.

translations.literal: " It was approved.)〉
translations.idiomatic: Approved.)〉

sentences.zh: 是日，帝幸左龍武軍。

translations.literal: That day the Emperor visited the Left Dragon Martial Army.
translations.idiomatic: That day Cunxu visited the Left Dragon Martial Army.

sentences.zh: 癸未，宰臣豆盧革率百官上表，請立中宮。

translations.literal: On guimao chief minister Dou Luge led the hundred officials in a memorial asking that the inner palace be established.
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Dou Luge and the officials asked for an empress.

sentences.zh: 製以魏國夫人劉氏為皇后，仍令所司擇日備禮冊命。

translations.literal: A pronouncement made Lady Liu of Wei state empress and ordered the relevant office to choose a day and prepare the full investiture rite.
translations.idiomatic: Empress Liu of Wei was proclaimed and a day set for full investiture.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，以天平軍節度使、蕃漢總管副使、開府儀同三司、檢校太傅、兼中書令李嗣源為檢校太尉，依前天平軍節度使，加實封百戶，兼賜鐵券；

translations.literal: On dinghai Tianping military commissioner, Han-Chinese chief deputy, acting Grand Preceptor, and chief minister Li Siyuan was made Grand Preceptor, remaining Tianping commissioner, with a hundred added real households and an iron tally;
translations.idiomatic: On dinghai Li Siyuan became Grand Preceptor, kept Tianping, gained a hundred households and an iron tally;

sentences.zh: 以前安國軍節度副使、檢校太保、左衛上將軍李存乂為晉州節度使、檢校太傅；

translations.literal: former Anguo deputy commissioner, Grand Guardian, and General of the Left Guards Li Cunyi was made Jinzhou military commissioner and Grand Mentor;
translations.idiomatic: Li Cunyi became Jin commissioner and Grand Mentor;

sentences.zh: 以北京皇城留守、檢校太保、左威衛上將軍李存紀為邢州節度使，加檢校太傅；

translations.literal: northern capital inner-city commandant, Grand Guardian, and General of the Left Awe Guards Li Cunji was made Xingzhou military commissioner and Grand Mentor;
translations.idiomatic: Cunji became Xing commissioner and Grand Mentor;

sentences.zh: 以蕃漢馬步都虞候兼東京馬步軍都指揮使、檢校太保朱守殷為振武節度使，加檢校太傅。

translations.literal: Han-Chinese horse-and-foot chief of staff and eastern-capital horse-and-foot commander, Grand Guardian Zhu Shouyin was made Zhenwu military commissioner and Grand Mentor.
translations.idiomatic: and Zhu Shouyin became Zhenwu commissioner and Grand Mentor.

sentences.zh: 戊子，以前右龍武軍都虞候、守左龍武大將軍李紹奇為鄭州防禦使，以楚州防禦使張繼孫為汝州防禦使。

translations.literal: On wuzi former Right Dragon Martial chief of staff and acting Left Dragon Martial general Li Shaoqi was made Zhengzhou defender; Chuzhou defender Zhang Jisun was made Ruzhou defender.
translations.idiomatic: On wuzi Li Shaoqi became Zheng defender and Zhang Jisun Ruzhou defender.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以振武軍節度使、權安義留後、檢校太傅、平章事李存霸為潞州節度使，以捧日都指揮使、鄭州防禦使李紹琛為陝州節度使，以成德軍馬步軍都指揮使、右監門衛大將軍毛璋為華州節度使。

translations.literal: On jichou Zhenwu military commissioner, acting Anyi regent, Grand Mentor, and chief minister Li Cunba was made Luzhou military commissioner; Sun-Rising commander and Zhengzhou defender Li Shaochen was made Shanzhou military commissioner; Chengde horse-and-foot commander and Right Gate Guard general Mao Zhang was made Huazhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Cunba took Luzhou, Li Shaochen Shanzhou, and Mao Zhang Huazhou.

sentences.zh: 壬辰，樞密使郭崇韜再上表，請退樞密之職，優詔不允。

translations.literal: On renchen Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Guo Chongtao again memorialized asking to resign the bureau post; a gracious edict refused.
translations.idiomatic: On renchen Guo Chongtao again asked to leave the bureau; Cunxu graciously refused.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，詔曰：「皇太后母儀天下，子視群生，當別建宮闈，顯標名號，冀因稱謂，益表尊嚴，宜以長壽宮為名。

translations.literal: On guisi an edict said: "The Empress Dowager is mother to all under heaven and regards the multitude as children; she should have a separate palace and a clear title, that by its name her dignity may stand forth—the name Changshou Palace is fitting."
translations.idiomatic: On guisi an edict named the Empress Dowager's palace Changshou to mark her dignity.

sentences.zh: 」樞密使郭崇韜奏時務利便一十五件，優詔褒美。

translations.literal: Bureau of Military Affairs commissioner Guo Chongtao memorialized fifteen items on timely profit and convenience; a gracious edict praised them.
translations.idiomatic: Guo Chongtao submitted fifteen reforms; Cunxu praised them.

sentences.zh: 甲午，奚王李紹威、吐渾李紹魯皆貢駝馬。

translations.literal: On jiawu Xi king Li Shaowei and Tuyuhun Li Shaolu both presented camels and horses.
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Li Shaowei of Xi and Li Shaolu of Tuyuhun brought camels and horses.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，以武安軍衙內馬步軍都指揮使、昭州刺史馬希範為永州刺史、檢校太保。

translations.literal: On dingyou Wuan inner horse-and-foot commander and Zhaozhou prefect Ma Xifan was made Yongzhou prefect and Grand Guardian.
translations.idiomatic: On dingyou Ma Xifan of Wuan became Yong prefect and Grand Guardian.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，以光祿大夫、檢校左僕射、行太常卿李燕為特進、檢校司空，依前太常卿；

translations.literal: On guimao Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, acting Left Vice Director, and acting Grand Master of Splendid Happiness Li Yan was made Special Counselor and acting Minister of Works, remaining Grand Master of Splendid Happiness;
translations.idiomatic: On guimao Li Yan became Special Counselor and acting Minister of Works while keeping the Grand Mastership;

sentences.zh: 以御史中丞李德休為兵部侍郎；

translations.literal: Censor-in-chief Li Detiu was made Vice Minister of War;
translations.idiomatic: Li Detiu, censor-in-chief, became vice minister of war;

sentences.zh: 以吏部侍郎崔協為御史中丞。

translations.literal: Vice Minister of Personnel Cui Xie was made Censor-in-chief.
translations.idiomatic: Cui Xie of Personnel became censor-in-chief.

sentences.zh: 三月甲辰，故河陽節度使王師範贈太尉。

translations.literal: Third month, jiachen: the late Heyang military commissioner Wang Shifan was posthumously made Grand Commandant.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month on jiachen the late Heyang commissioner Wang Shifan was posthumously made Grand Commandant.

sentences.zh: 乙巳，以滄州節度使、檢校太傅、同平章事符習為青州節度使，以北京衙內馬步軍都指揮使、右領軍衛大將軍李紹斌為滄州節度使。

translations.literal: On yisi, Cangzhou military commissioner, acting Grand Tutor, and co-equal chief minister Fu Xi was made Qingzhou military commissioner; the northern capital's inner horse-and-foot commander and Right Imperial Guard general Li Shaobin was made Cangzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On yisi Fu Xi of Cangzhou—acting Grand Tutor and chancellor—went to Qing, and Li Shaobin, inner horse-and-foot commander of the northern capital and Right Guard general, took Cang.

sentences.zh: 鎮州奏，契丹犯塞，詔李嗣源率師屯邢州。

translations.literal: Zhen prefecture reported that the Khitan had raided the frontier; an edict ordered Li Siyuan to lead troops and encamp at Xingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Zhen reported a Khitan raid; Li Siyuan was ordered to march and camp at Xing.

sentences.zh: 丙午，以荊南節度使、守中書令、渤海王高季興依前檢校太師、兼尚書令，封南平王；

translations.literal: On bingwu, Jingnan military commissioner, acting Secretariat Director, and Prince of Bohai Gao Jixing remained acting Grand Preceptor and concurrent Director of the Imperial Secretariat, and was enfeoffed Prince of Nanping;
translations.idiomatic: On bingwu Gao Jixing of Jingnan kept acting Grand Preceptor and Director of the Imperial Secretariat and was made Prince of Nanping;

sentences.zh: 以幽州節度行軍司馬李存賢依前檢校太保，為幽州節度使。

translations.literal: Youzhou military commissioner's campaign army marshal Li Cunxian remained acting Grand Guardian and was made Youzhou military commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: Li Cunxian, Youzhou campaign marshal, stayed acting Grand Guardian and became Youzhou commissioner.

sentences.zh: 中書門下上言：「近以諸州奏薦令錄，頗亂規程，請今後節度使管三州已上，每年許奏管內官三人；

translations.literal: The Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized: "Recently the various prefectures have memorialized recommended magistrates and recorders in ways that greatly disorder the regulations; we ask that hereafter military commissioners who administer three prefectures or more may each year memorialize three officers within their circuits;
translations.idiomatic: The Secretariat reported, "Prefectures have been recommending magistrates in disorder; hereafter a commissioner over three or more prefectures may nominate three circuit officers a year;

sentences.zh: 如管三州已下，隻奏兩人。

translations.literal: if administering fewer than three prefectures, only two may be memorialized.
translations.idiomatic: with fewer than three prefectures, only two;

sentences.zh: 仍須課績尤異，方得上聞。

translations.literal: They must moreover have outstanding performance evaluations before the matter may reach the throne.
translations.idiomatic: only with outstanding evaluations might a name go up;

sentences.zh: 防禦使止許奏一人，刺史無奏薦之例。

translations.literal: Defense commissioners may memorialize only one person; prefects have no precedent for memorial recommendation.
translations.idiomatic: defense commissioners one each, and prefects none."

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: 」The edict was approved.

sentences.zh: 己酉，以太子少保李琪為刑部尚書

translations.literal: On jiyou, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Li Qi was made Minister of Punishments
translations.idiomatic: On jiyou Li Qi, Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent, became minister of punishments

sentences.zh: 庚戌，幽州奏，契丹寇新城。

translations.literal: On gengxu, Youzhou reported that the Khitan had raided Xincheng.
translations.idiomatic: On gengxu Youzhou reported a Khitan strike on Xincheng.

sentences.zh: 是日，詔：「諸軍將校，自檢校司空以下，宜賜葉謀定亂匡國功臣。

translations.literal: That day an edict: "All army commanders from acting Sikong and below are to be granted the merit title Merit Lord Who Counsels Plans, Settles Disorder, and Stabilizes the State.
translations.idiomatic: That day an edict granted every army commander from acting Sikong down the merit title Merit Lord Who Counsels Plans, Settles Disorder, and Stabilizes the State.

sentences.zh: 自檢校僕射、尚書、常侍及諫議大夫，並賜忠果拱衛功臣。

translations.literal: Those from acting Vice Director, Minister, regular attendant, and remonstrance grandee are all to be granted the merit title Loyal Fruition, Arched Guard Merit Lord.
translations.idiomatic: Acting vice directors, ministers, regular attendants, and remonstrance grandees received Loyal Fruition, Arched Guard Merit Lord.

sentences.zh: 初帶憲銜者，並賜忠烈功臣。

translations.literal: Those first bearing censorial titles are all to be granted the merit title Loyal Martyr Merit Lord.
translations.idiomatic: Those first holding censorial titles received Loyal Martyr Merit Lord.

sentences.zh: 節級長行，並賜扈蹕功臣。

translations.literal: Those in sequential rank steps are all to be granted the merit title Imperial Escort Merit Lord.
translations.idiomatic: Those advancing by sequential rank received Imperial Escort Merit Lord.

sentences.zh: 」中書門下上言：「州縣官在任考滿，即具關申送吏部格式，本道不得差攝官替正官。

translations.literal: 」The Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized: "When a prefecture or county officer completes his term in office, he shall at once submit the closing report in the Personnel format; the circuit may not substitute an acting officer for the regular appointee.
translations.idiomatic: 」The Secretariat added, "When a district officer finishes his term he must file the Personnel closing report; the circuit may not replace the appointee with an acting officer.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: 」The throne approved.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《五代會要》：同光二年，中書門下奏：「刺史、縣令有政績尤異，為眾所知；

translations.literal: (The 《Institutes of the Five Dynasties》: In Tongguang 2 the Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized: "Where a prefect or magistrate has outstanding achievement known to the multitude;
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Five Dynasties Institutes》 says in Tongguang 2 the Secretariat reported, "Where a prefect or magistrate is known for outstanding achievement;

sentences.zh: 或招復戶口，能增加賦稅者；

translations.literal: or has recovered households and increased tax levies;
translations.idiomatic: or has recovered households and increased taxes;

sentences.zh: 或辨雪冤獄，能拯人命者；

translations.literal: or has cleared wrongful cases and saved lives;
translations.idiomatic: or has cleared wrongful cases and saved lives;

sentences.zh: 或去害物之積弊，立利世之新規，有益時政，為眾所推者，即仰本處逐件分明聞奏，當議獎擢。

translations.literal: or has removed accumulated harms and established new rules benefiting the age, with benefit to current government and recommendation by the multitude—then the locality is to report each case clearly to the throne, and reward and promotion shall be deliberated.
translations.idiomatic: or has swept away long abuses, set new rules for the age, and won public praise—the locality should report each case and promotion should be considered.

sentences.zh: 或在任貪猥，誅戮生靈，公事不治，為政怠惰，亦加懲罰。

translations.literal: Or if while in office he was greedy and base, slaughtered the people, did not handle public affairs, or was slack in government, punishment is also to be added.
translations.idiomatic: Greedy rule, killing subjects, neglect of office, or slack government should also be punished.

sentences.zh: 其州縣官任滿三考，即具關申送吏部格式，候敕除銓注，其本道不得差攝官替正授者。

translations.literal: When a prefecture or county officer completes three term evaluations, he shall at once submit the closing report in the Personnel format and await an edict for appointment and assignment; the circuit may not substitute an acting officer for the regular appointee.
translations.idiomatic: After three evaluations an officer must file the Personnel closing report and await imperial assignment; the circuit may not replace him with an acting officer.

translations.literal: 」It was followed.)〉
translations.idiomatic: 」The request was granted.)〉

sentences.zh: 有司上言：「皇帝四月一日禦文明殿，受冊徽號，合服袞冕，御殿前一日，散齋於內殿。

translations.literal: The responsible offices memorialized: "On the first day of the fourth month the Emperor will attend the Civilized Hall, receive the seal and honorific title, and should wear the dragon robe and coronet; on the day before attending the hall he shall fast and abstain in the inner hall.
translations.idiomatic: The rites offices reported, "On the first of the fourth month the Emperor will take the honorific at Civilized Hall in dragon robe and crown; the day before he should fast in the inner hall.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: 」The court agreed.

sentences.zh: 是日，李嗣源上表乞退兵權，詔不允。

translations.literal: That day Li Siyuan submitted a memorial begging to relinquish military authority; an edict did not permit it.
translations.idiomatic: That day Li Siyuan asked to give up military command; the throne refused.

sentences.zh: 是時伶人景進用事，閹官競進，故重臣憂懼，拜章請退。

translations.literal: At that time the actor Jing Jin held power, and eunuchs vied for advancement; hence the great ministers were fearful and submitted memorials asking to withdraw.
translations.idiomatic: The actor Jing Jin then held sway and eunuchs crowded forward, so great ministers feared for themselves and begged to step down.

sentences.zh: 癸丑，左諫議大夫竇專上言：「請廢租庸使名目，事歸三司。

translations.literal: On guichou, Left Remonstrance Grandee Dou Zhuan memorialized: "We ask to abolish the rent-and-corvée commissioner title and return the matter to the Three Offices.
translations.idiomatic: On guichou Dou Zhuan, Left Remonstrance Grandee, asked to abolish the rent-and-corvée commissioner and restore revenue to the Three Offices.

sentences.zh: 」疏奏不報。

translations.literal: 」The memorial was submitted but received no reply.
translations.idiomatic: 」The memorial went unanswered.

sentences.zh: 唐州奏，木連理。

translations.literal: Tang prefecture reported that trees had grown joined in one trunk.
translations.idiomatic: Tang reported trees growing with conjoined trunks.

sentences.zh: 詔：「先省員官，除已別授官外，其左散騎常侍李文矩等三十人卻復舊官，太子詹事石戩等五人宜以本官致仕，將作少監岑保嗣等十四人續敕處分。

translations.literal: An edict: "First reduce redundant posts; apart from those already given other appointments, the thirty persons including Left Regular Attendant of the Scattered Cavalry Li Wenju are to return to their former offices; the five persons including Grand Mentor of the Heir Apparent Shi Jian are to retire on their present offices; the fourteen persons including Assistant Director of Palace Construction Cen Baosi await further edict disposition.
translations.idiomatic: An edict trimmed redundant posts: apart from those already reassigned, thirty including Li Wenju of Scattered Cavalry returned to old posts; five including Shi Jian of the Heir Apparent retired on present rank; fourteen including Cen Baosi awaited further orders.

sentences.zh: 」丙辰，責授萊州司戶鄭玨等一十一人並量移近地。

translations.literal: 」On bingchen, the eleven persons including demoted Laizhou revenue clerk Zheng Jue were all transferred by measure to nearer places.
translations.idiomatic: 」On bingchen eleven demoted officers including Zheng Jue of Laizhou were moved nearer the capital.

sentences.zh: 尚書戶部侍郎、知貢舉趙頎卒，以中書舍人裴皞權知貢舉。

translations.literal: Minister of Revenue Vice Minister and director of the examinations Zhao Yan died; Secretariat drafter Pei Hao was made acting director of the examinations.
translations.idiomatic: Zhao Yan, Revenue vice minister and examination director, died; Pei Hao of the Secretariat took the examinations in his stead.

sentences.zh: 禁用鉛錫錢。

translations.literal: Lead and tin coin were forbidden.
translations.idiomatic: Lead and tin coin were banned.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，中書門下奏：「懿祖陵請以永興為名，獻祖陵請以長寧為名，太祖陵請以建極為名。

translations.literal: On dingsi, the Secretariat and Chancellery memorialized: "The Yizong tomb is to be named Yongxing, the Xianzong tomb Changning, and the Taizu tomb Jianji.
translations.idiomatic: On dingsi the Secretariat asked that the Yizong tomb be called Yongxing, the Xianzong tomb Changning, and the Taizu tomb Jianji.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: 」It was followed.
translations.idiomatic: 」The throne approved.

sentences.zh: 淮南楊溥遣使貢賀郊天禮物。

translations.literal: Yang Pu of Huainan sent envoys with tribute congratulating the suburban sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Pu of Huainan sent envoys with gifts for the suburban rites.

translations.literal: 〈Bracket note
translations.idiomatic: 〈Note

sentences.zh: （《十國春秋·吳世家》：王遣右衛上將軍許確進賀郊天銀二千兩、錦綺羅一千二百匹、細茶五百斤、象牙四株、犀角十株於唐。）〉

translations.literal: (The 《Spring and Autumn of the Ten States · Wu Annals》 says: The king sent Right Guard senior general Xu Que to present to Tang two thousand liang of silver for congratulating the suburban sacrifice, one thousand two hundred bolts of brocade silk, five hundred jin of fine tea, four tusks of ivory, and ten rhinoceros horns.)〉
translations.idiomatic: (The 《Ten States Spring and Autumn · Wu Annals》 says the king sent Xu Que with two thousand liang of silver, twelve hundred bolts of brocade, five hundred jin of fine tea, four ivory tusks, and ten rhinoceros horns for Tang's suburban rites.)〉

sentences.zh: 戊午，詔應南郊行事官，並付三銓磨勘，優與處分。

translations.literal: On wuwu, an edict ordered that officials who took part in the southern suburban rites all be put through the three selection boards for review and given favorable disposition.
translations.idiomatic: On wuwu every officer who served at the southern suburb was to pass the three selection boards and receive favorable treatment.

sentences.zh: 己未，以大理卿張紹珪充製置安邑、解縣兩池榷鹽使。

translations.literal: On jiwei, Court of Judicial Review director Zhang Shaogui was made commissioner for arranging the salt monopoly of the Anyi and Jie county pools.
translations.idiomatic: On jiwei Zhang Shaogui of Judicial Review was made salt-monopoly commissioner for the Anyi and Jie pools.

sentences.zh: 幸左龍武軍，以皇子繼岌代張全義判六軍諸衛事故也。

translations.literal: The Emperor visited the Left Dragon Martial Army because the prince Jiji was replacing Zhang Quanyi in overseeing the Six Armies and Imperial Guards.
translations.idiomatic: Cunxu visited the Left Dragon Martial Army as Prince Jiji took over Zhang Quanyi's charge of the Six Armies and Guards.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，以彰武、保大等軍節度使、北平王高萬興可依前延州鄜州節度使、檢校太保、兼中書令、北平王。

translations.literal: On guihai, Zhangwu and Baoda army military commissioner and Prince of Beiping Gao Wanxing remained Yanzhou and Mizhou military commissioner, acting Grand Guardian, concurrent Secretariat Director, and Prince of Beiping as before.
translations.idiomatic: On guihai Gao Wanxing of Zhangwu and Baoda kept Yan and Mi, acting Grand Guardian, Secretariat Director, and Prince of Beiping.

sentences.zh: 甲子，幸東宅。

translations.literal: On jiazi, the Emperor visited the eastern residence.
translations.idiomatic: On jiazi Cunxu visited the eastern residence.

sentences.zh: 夏四月己巳朔，帝御文明殿，具袞冕，受冊尊號曰昭文睿武至德光孝皇帝。

translations.literal: Summer, fourth month, jisi new moon: the Emperor attended Civilized Hall, donned the dragon robe and coronet, and received the seal and honorific title Zhaowen Ruiwu Zhide Guangxiao Emperor.
translations.idiomatic: On the jisi new moon of the fourth month Cunxu took dragon robe and crown at Civilized Hall and received the honorific Zhaowen Ruiwu Zhide Guangxiao Emperor.

sentences.zh: 壬申，以成德軍節度行軍司馬、權知府事任圜為檢校右僕射、權北面水陸轉運製置使。

translations.literal: On renshen, Chengde army campaign army marshal and acting prefect Ren Yuan was made acting Right Vice Director and acting northern land-and-water transport commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On renshen Ren Yuan, Chengde campaign marshal and acting prefect, became acting Right Vice Director and northern transport commissioner.

sentences.zh: 甲戌，以順義軍留後華溫琪依前檢校太保，充留後。

translations.literal: On jiaxu, Shunyi Army acting military commissioner Hua Wenqi remained acting Grand Guardian and continued as acting commissioner.
translations.idiomatic: On jiaxu Hua Wenqi of Shunyi kept acting Grand Guardian and stayed as acting commissioner.

sentences.zh: 乙亥，以天策上將軍、武安等軍節度使、守太師、中書令、楚王馬殷可依前守太師，兼尚書令。

translations.literal: On yihai, Celestial Stratagem senior general, Wu'an and other circuits military commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, Secretariat Director, and Prince of Chu Ma Yin remained acting Grand Preceptor and was made concurrent Director of the Imperial Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: On yihai Ma Yin of Chu—Celestial Stratagem general, Wu'an commissioner, acting Grand Preceptor, and chancellor—kept Grand Preceptor and took Director of the Imperial Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 詔在京諸道節度使、刺史、令各歸本任。

translations.literal: An edict ordered military commissioners, prefects, and magistrates of every circuit at the capital each to return to his post.
translations.idiomatic: An edict sent every commissioner, prefect, and magistrate at court back to his post.

sentences.zh: 丁丑，以前幽州節度使、內外蕃漢馬步總管、檢校太師、兼中書令李存審為宣武軍節度使，餘如故。

translations.literal: On dingchou, former Youzhou military commissioner, inner and outer barbarian and Chinese horse-and-foot commander-in-chief, acting Grand Preceptor, and concurrent Secretariat Director Li Cunshen was made Xuanwu army military commissioner, the rest as before.
translations.idiomatic: On dingchou Li Cunshen—former Youzhou commissioner, barbarian-and-Chinese commander-in-chief, acting Grand Preceptor, and chancellor—became Xuanwu commissioner, the rest unchanged.

sentences.zh: 己卯，帝御文明殿，冊魏國夫人劉氏為皇后。

translations.literal: On jimao, the Emperor attended Civilized Hall and enfeoffed Lady Liu of Wei as empress.
translations.idiomatic: On jimao Cunxu enfeoffed Lady Liu of Wei as empress at Civilized Hall.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，賜霍彥威姓，名曰紹真。

translations.literal: On gengchen, Huo Yanwei was granted the surname and given the name Shaozhen.
translations.idiomatic: On gengchen Huo Yanwei took the imperial surname with the name Shaozhen.

sentences.zh: 癸未，以宋州節度使李繼安依前檢校太尉、同平章事、宋州節度使；

translations.literal: On guiwei, Songzhou military commissioner Li Ji'an remained acting Grand Commandant, co-equal chief minister, and Songzhou military commissioner as before;
translations.idiomatic: On guiwei Li Ji'an of Song kept acting Grand Commandant, chancellor, and Song commission;

sentences.zh: 以許州節度使李繼衝依前檢校太尉、同平章事、許州節度使；

translations.literal: Xuzhou military commissioner Li Jichong remained acting Grand Commandant, co-equal chief minister, and Xuzhou military commissioner as before;
translations.idiomatic: Li Jichong of Xu kept acting Grand Commandant, chancellor, and Xu commission;

sentences.zh: 以襄州節度使孔依前檢校太傅、同平章事、襄州節度使。

translations.literal: Xiangzhou military commissioner Kong remained acting Grand Tutor, co-equal chief minister, and Xiangzhou military commissioner as before.
translations.idiomatic: Kong of Xiang kept acting Grand Tutor, chancellor, and Xiang commission.

sentences.zh: 甲午，以樞密副使、通議大夫、行內侍省內侍宋唐玉為左監門衛將軍同正，依前樞密副使；

translations.literal: On jiawu, Bureau of Military Affairs deputy commissioner, General-of-Policy Grandee, and acting Inner Palace eunuch Song Tangyu was made Left Gate Guard general of the same rank, remaining Bureau of Military Affairs deputy commissioner as before;
translations.idiomatic: On jiawu Song Tangyu—deputy Military Affairs commissioner and acting Inner Palace eunuch—became Left Gate Guard general of the same rank while keeping his deputy post;

sentences.zh: 以內客省使、通議大夫、行內侍省內侍楊希朗為右監門衛將軍同正，依前內客省使：並賜推忠匡佐功臣。

translations.literal: Inner Reception Bureau commissioner, General-of-Policy Grandee, and acting Inner Palace eunuch Yang Xilang was made Right Gate Guard general of the same rank, remaining Inner Reception Bureau commissioner as before: both were granted the merit title Push Loyalty, Support the Throne Merit Lord.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Xilang of the Inner Reception Bureau became Right Gate Guard general of the same rank and kept his bureau; both men received Push Loyalty, Support the Throne Merit Lord.

sentences.zh: 車駕幸龍門。

translations.literal: The imperial progress visited Longmen.
translations.idiomatic: The court went to Longmen.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，回鶻遣使貢方物。

translations.literal: On bingxu, the Uyghurs sent envoys presenting local products.
translations.idiomatic: On bingxu Uyghur envoys brought tribute.

sentences.zh: 己丑，以夏州節度使李仁福依前檢校太師、兼中書令、夏州節度使，封朔方王；

translations.literal: On jichou, Xiazhou military commissioner Li Renfu remained acting Grand Preceptor, concurrent Secretariat Director, and Xiazhou military commissioner, and was enfeoffed Prince of Shuofang;
translations.idiomatic: On jichou Li Renfu of Xia kept acting Grand Preceptor, chancellor, and Xia commission and was made Prince of Shuofang;

sentences.zh: 以朔方、河西等軍節度使韓洙依前檢校太傅、兼侍中，充朔方、河西等軍節度使，靈、鹽、威、警、雄、涼、甘、肅等州觀察使。

translations.literal: Shuofang and Hexi army military commissioner Han Zhu remained acting Grand Tutor and concurrent Palace Attendant, and was made Shuofang and Hexi army military commissioner and commissioner of Ling, Yan, Wei, Jing, Xiong, Liang, Gan, and Su prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Han Zhu of Shuofang and Hexi kept acting Grand Tutor and Palace Attendant and took those commissions plus observation of Ling, Yan, Wei, Jing, Xiong, Liang, Gan, and Su.

sentences.zh: 辛卯，以宣徽南院使、判內侍省、兼內局、特進、左監門將軍同正李紹宏為右領軍衛上將軍。

translations.literal: On xinmao, Palace Attendant of the Southern Court of the Palace Secretariat, overseer of the Inner Palace, concurrent Inner Bureau, Special Grandee, and Left Gate Guard general of the same rank Li Shaohong was made senior general of the Right Imperial Guard.
translations.idiomatic: On xinmao Li Shaohong—Southern Secretariat attendant, Inner Palace overseer, Special Grandee, and Left Gate Guard general—became senior general of the Right Guard.

sentences.zh: 癸巳，以靜江軍節度使、扶風郡王馬賨為檢校太師、兼中書令，依前靜江軍節度使；

translations.literal: On guisi, Jingjiang army military commissioner and Prince of Fufeng Ma Cong was made acting Grand Preceptor and concurrent Secretariat Director, remaining Jingjiang army military commissioner as before;
translations.idiomatic: On guisi Ma Cong of Jingjiang—Prince of Fufeng—became acting Grand Preceptor and chancellor while keeping Jingjiang;

sentences.zh: 以朗州節度使馬希振為檢校太傅、兼侍中，依前朗州節度使。

translations.literal: Langzhou military commissioner Ma Xizhen was made acting Grand Tutor and concurrent Palace Attendant, remaining Langzhou military commissioner as before.
translations.idiomatic: Ma Xizhen of Lang became acting Grand Tutor and Palace Attendant and kept Lang.

sentences.zh: 鳳翔節度使、秦王李茂貞薨。

translations.literal: Fengxiang military commissioner and Prince of Qin Li Maozhen died.
translations.idiomatic: Li Maozhen, Fengxiang commissioner and Prince of Qin, died.

sentences.zh: 丙申，潞州小校楊立據城叛，以李嗣源為招討使，陝州留後李紹真為副，率師以討之。

translations.literal: On bingchen, Luzhou junior officer Yang Li seized the city in rebellion; Li Siyuan was made pacification commissioner, Shaanzhou acting commissioner Li Shaozhen deputy, and they led troops to attack him.
translations.idiomatic: On bingchen Yang Li, a Luzhou junior officer, rebelled and held the city; Li Siyuan was made pacification commissioner with Li Shaozhen of Shaan as deputy to march against him.
